title: Navigation Assistant
subtitle: Learning the Northern Route
bodyText: A navigation assistant checks bearings, compares coastal landmarks, and records the observations needed to keep an expedition on course. Practical work beside experienced navigators prepares the eye and judgment for independent observation.
sceneBrief: An adult navigation assistant works on bearings, coastal landmarks or a voyage record aboard an ancient expedition vessel; no provision-loading task.
rarityCharacteristics: antique bronze, paired rules, leaf corners
